title: Best Streak
statement:
A streamer records how many followers they gained each day for **n** days (a negative number means they lost followers). They want to show off their best period of exactly **k** consecutive days.

Find the maximum total gain over any **k** consecutive days.
input:
The first line contains two integers **n** and **k**.

The second line contains n integers a[1], ..., a[n].
output: Print one integer: the largest sum of k consecutive elements.

samples.explanation: The window sums are 3, 7, 8, 7 and -4. The best one is days 3 to 5: 4 + 5 - 1 = 8.

hints: Recomputing every window from scratch takes O(n·k), which is too slow when k is about n / 2.
Slide the window: when it moves one step right, add the new element and subtract the element that leaves.
Sums can reach 2·10^14: use 64-bit integers. The answer can be negative.
editorial:
Compute the sum of the first k elements. Then slide the window one position at a time: the new sum is the old sum plus a[i] minus a[i - k]. Keep the maximum of all window sums. (Prefix sums give the same result: the window ending at i has sum p[i] - p[i - k].)

Start the maximum from the first window, not from 0, because all sums may be negative.

Complexity: O(n).
